title: Spatial Patterns of Seed Plants and Their Conservation Priorities in Jiangxi Province, China中国江西省种子植物的空间格局及其保护优先区
content:
We comprehensively evaluated the seed plant diversity of Jiangxi province to address the regional biodiversity conservation of Asian subtropical evergreen broad-leaved forests (EBLFs). Higher species diversity of seed plants was observed in eastern, southern, and western Jiangxi, with elevation and precipitation as mainly environmental factors. The conservation gaps mainly concentrate on areas near mountains. Current reserves only cover 50.6% of seed plant species, and would increase to 61.4% in conservation priority areas.


ABSTRACT

Identifying and protecting biodiversity hotspots is crucial for regional biodiversity conservation. Jiangxi province lies in the core of Asian subtropical evergreen broad-leaved forests (EBLFs), which provides an ideal region to comprehensively address the regional biodiversity conservation. We combined elevation and land-cover data to filter seed plant occurrences, evaluated the spatial patterns of seed plants at the county level and across 11 spatial grain sizes, and then identified the conservation priority areas. We have delineated more detailed spatial phylogenetic patterns at the 10 × 10 km2 grid cells level. Our results suggested that higher species richness (SR) and phylogenetic diversity (PD) were observed in eastern, southern, and western Jiangxi. In contrast, a lower standard effective size of PD (ses.PD) was observed in northeastern, southern, and northwestern Jiangxi. Both the higher net relatedness index (NRI) and the higher nearest taxon index (NTI) occurred in the areas around the Huaiyu Mountains, northern Nanling Mountains, and Mufu Mountains. Elevation and precipitation were mainly contributed to the spatial patterns of seed plants in Jiangxi province. Overall, 471 grid cells were identified as conservation priority areas, including most of mountains and Poyang Lake. The species “covered” in current protected areas reached 50.6% and would increase to 61.4% in conservation priority areas. The conservation gaps mainly concentrate on areas near mountains. Our results highlight that biodiversity conservation in EBLFs should pay attention to mountains with high elevation.

摘要

生物多样性保护日益受到重视。识别和保护物种丰富度 (SR) 与系统发育多样性 (PD) 热点, 对于区域生物多样性保护至关重要。在此, 我们综合评估了江西省种子植物多样性, 以服务于亚洲亚热带常绿阔叶林 (EBLFs) 的区域生物多样性保护。我们首次结合海拔和土地利用数据筛选种子植物分布记录, 在县级和11个网格单元水平上评估了种子植物的空间格局, 进而识别了保护优先区。我们在10×10 km2网格尺度上探讨了更精细的系统发育空间格局。结果表明, 江西省东部、南部和西部的SR和PD较高；相比之下, 东北部、南部和西北部的系统发育多样性标准化效应值 (ses.PD) 较低。更高的净亲缘指数 (NRI) 与最近种间亲缘关系指数 (NTI) 分布在怀玉山、南岭山脉北段、幕阜山周边区域。海拔与降水量是塑造江西省种子植物空间格局的主要环境因子。总体而言, 共识别出471个网格单元为保护优先区, 涵盖大部分山地和鄱阳湖。当前保护区内“覆盖”的物种比例达到50.6%, 在保护优先区将增至61.4%。保护空缺主要集中在山地附近区域。这些研究结果强调亚热带常绿阔叶林的生物多样性保护应重点关注高海拔山地。
